trials.finding: Both Markdown reference targets are broken from artifact.md. Repository-relative prose does not change Markdown URL resolution. Sources remain manually recoverable from printed paths.
Both source hyperlinks incorrectly resolve beneath the trial directory; printed repository-relative paths remain manually recoverable.
Explicit repository-relative fixture root plus accurate plain file:line references supports recovery. No Markdown hyperlinks are advertised.
Explicit fixture-root declaration and accurate plain file:line references support recovery; static inspection and mediated saving are accurately disclosed.
References are declared relative to the fixture root, but the artifact never identifies that root. Source retrieval requires the packet or trace; the standalone artifact is less recoverable.
All 13 inline source hyperlinks resolve to absent files under the trial directory. The explicit fixture-root text supports manual recovery but does not repair hyperlinks.

link_check.method: Read-only path resolution from each artifact.md parent directory, removing URL fragments before checking existence.

authority.evidence: All six tool-events.json files contain package/request/fixture reads and file discovery; no application execution, writes, delegation, or network calls observed.
authority.qualification: A3 and B3 enumerate wave1 filenames outside the fixture through rg --files, including trial names. No other trial artifact contents were read in those traces.

limitations: Mediated saving does not test autonomous scratch, destination selection, publication, or interaction fallback.
Recorded model metadata does not authenticate serving-model identity.
Read-only traces are observation, not filesystem enforcement.
Mermaid semantics were reviewed as source; no rendered visual inspection was performed.
No arm superiority follows from these six outputs.

failure_groups.evidence: A validation exits 0 instead of 1. A resolves task files lexically and does not inspect path segments; B invokes includeLeaf containment.
A validation exits 0. B adds Git-internals rejection, case-normalized matching and additional managed surfaces.

failure_groups.tests: task-pack-command: selected child repo rather than artifact root
failure_groups.evidence: A fails the initial rejection assertion for a symlink inside the selected child. B resolves target scope before file containment. Recovery assertions were not reached in A.
A exits successfully but resolved_target_repo is undefined. Source confirms B adds this output and target-resolution mechanism; these test failures alone do not demonstrate a wrong write.

Leaf fails at addManagedExclude.ok; ancestor passes add rejection then fails at removeManagedExclude.ok. Do not describe both as observed outside writes. B inspects dangling links before absence shortcuts.

A snapshot changes HEAD and worktree identity under overrides. Failure is at the snapshot assertion; later source-snapshot and exclude-write assertions were not reached. B routes snapshot Git reads through environment-sanitized runGit.

A reports created rather than failed. Source uses a direct path write after an existence-based dangling-link check; B uses contained staging. Later outside-file and recovery assertions were not reached in A.
A actually changes the outside hardlink peer, shown by its returned content diff. Permission and temporary-file assertions were not reached. B stages a new inode and renames.

Injector runs only when writeFileSync receives a numeric descriptor. B stages through a descriptor; A writes with a string filename, so no replacement is injected into A. A's updated status is not a paired race failure.
A returns no rejection for the first failing OpenCode case. The loop stops there, so the failure does not independently observe every later host.

failure_groups.tests: target-repo-containment: dangling ancestors and leaf links
failure_groups.evidence: A fails on the first dangling-ancestor assertion using the existing two-argument API. This failure is not caused by the later new includeLeaf option. Remaining cases were not reached.

The extractor requires a text fence beginning directly with git add. A has a bash fence with preceding temp-file setup, so match returns null before the recipe executes. Both source arms use explicit commit paths and -F; this result does not establish an A commit failure.

paired_mechanisms.wording_recommendation: Prefer observed baseline behavior deficits or behavior differences over regression: these results compare older A with newer B and do not establish that A regressed from an earlier version.
limitations: Reviewed saved Jest results, test drivers, and both source arms; did not rerun tests.
The 21 behavior failures are not 21 independent defects and are not model-quality gains.
Validation acceptance is not evidence of downstream mutation.
B-specific race coverage is bounded to the injected staging point, not general concurrent filesystem safety.
Deterministic mechanism results do not establish full Skill acceptance.
